name: Octree-GS
aliases: Towards Consistent Real-time Rendering with LOD-Structured 3D Gaussians
definition: A hierarchical LoD method that builds an octree over the scene, associating each node with a merged Gaussian that summarizes the radiance and opacity of its children.
summary: Octree-GS is a hierarchical 3D Gaussian Splatting method that uses an octree to dynamically select multi-scale primitives, solving performance and memory issues through end-to-end training without manual tuning.
